integrity: All equations, proof and reproducibility information are contained within this package. Bibliographic novelty remains subject to external literature discovery; the general randomized Kaczmarz algorithm and covariance lifting are not new.
scientific_limitations: Two linearly independent unit rows in the real plane; consistent equations; IID uniform row choice with replacement; constant step; deterministic starts; asymptotic expected squared error. No general larger-row, noisy, finite-horizon or pathwise assertion. Some older plausible exact-MSE and relaxation sources lacked full-text comparison.
title: Exact rate-optimal overrelaxation for two-row randomized Kaczmarz
